title: Distributions of Iwasawa $λ$-invariants of $\mathbf{Z}_p$-towers over supersingular isogeny graphs
summary: A graph-theoretic analogue of Iwasawa theory, initiated by Gonet and Vallières, has attracted considerable interest in the study of Iwasawa invariants. On the other hand, for a pair of prime numbers $(r,\ell)$, one obtains a graph, called the supersingular $\ell$-isogeny graph (SIG), whose adjacency matrix has eigenvalues given by the $\ell$-th Fourier coefficients of the weight 2 Eisenstein series and newforms of level $r$.
